subject: Invoice author + delivery conduit decision: portal opt-in or continue email copies
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@evergreenbio.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@evergreenbio.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice authoring + delivery conduit question

Hi Connor,

Quick question as we get set up for Evergreen: who will be the invoice AUTHOR in your model for our account? Our AP team needs to know whether Redwood will create and dispatch invoices (so we validate against PO# and remit) or whether we should continue to handle invoice creation on our side and expect notifications only.

Two delivery items for your ops team to confirm:
- Delivery channel: can you send invoices via your portal webhook/SFTP, or do we get full PDF copies to ap@evergreenbio.com by email? We prefer portal delivery but need an interim email copy while we onboard.
- Tax/VAT: Evergreen (EU entity) requires VAT evidence on the invoice and the PO reference on the invoice matching PR-9876. Please confirm you can populate EU VAT registration and include the reverse-charge wording when applicable.

Also: do you provide an XML schema sample? Our AP system ingests both PDF and XML.

If you can reply with the option you recommend and any onboarding checklist, that would be great — we need to lock this before the go-live next month.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
AP Lead, Evergreen Bio
emma.liu@evergreenbio.com
+44 20 8123 4456

--
Evergreen Bio | Accounts Payable
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@evergreenbio.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference.com>, AP Team <ap@evergreenbio.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice authoring + delivery conduit question

Emma — thanks for the clear note. Happy to confirm options and a recommended path.

Short answer: Redwood can be the invoice AUTHOR and push invoices both to our portal (preferred) and to an email copy during onboarding.

What we can do today (recommended rollout):
1) Authoring: Redwood issues the invoice PDF and XML (if you consume XML). We will populate PO PR-9876 into the invoice header and line-level if needed.
2) Delivery:
   - Preferred: enroll your AP system to our portal webhook/SFTP with daily invoice push. This gives deterministic delivery and early A/R reconciliation.
   - Interim: we will send PDF email copies to ap@evergreenbio.com until portal is live.
3) VAT / tax: we will include the VAT registration fields and can add the standard reverse-charge clause when you provide the EU VAT number and confirm the mechanism.

Attachments I'm sending in this thread: sample_invoice_redwood_001.pdf (PDF stub), invoice_xml_sample.xsd (XML schema), onboarding_checklist.xlsx (short tasks for portal enroll).

Next steps for Evergreen (ask to confirm):
- Confirm billing contact name and ap email to receive interim copies (you already have ap@evergreenbio.com).
- Confirm remit-to address and preferred remit entity (legal name + bank details) or attach PO with remit.
- Provide your EU VAT ID if reverse-charge should be applied.
- Let us know if you require Peppol/e-invoice standard — we support basic UBL/XML and Peppol on request (minor lead time).

I will loop in Kimberly on the VAT specifics for EU invoicing requirements. If you want, we can produce a sample invoice with PR-9876 populated before go-live so your AP can validate ingestion.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.inference.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@evergreenbio.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice authoring + delivery conduit question

Emma / Connor — quick VAT note from ops/legal side:

If Evergreen expects reverse-charge treatment, please provide the EU VAT registration number that should appear on the invoice as well as any local wording your AP team requires. Our standard template includes an optional field called "Tax Handling Note" where we insert the clause (e.g., "VAT reverse charge — Article 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC").

Operational requests:
- Please confirm the billing contact for invoice disputes (name + email + phone). This is separate from the payment remit contact.
- For portal onboarding, we will set "email_copies=on" by default so ap@evergreenbio.com continues to receive PDFs until you flip the portal to primary.
- If you need signed PDF invoices (certified), let us know; otherwise our standard PDFs meet typical AP ingestion.

I've attached a VAT evidence template (vat_evidence_template.pdf) you can use to upload ID/certificates to the portal.

Kimberly Park
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.inference.com
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@evergreenbio.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@evergreenbio.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice authoring + delivery conduit question

Thanks both — that works.

We will:
- Confirm Evergreen EU VAT ID: GB123456789 (please include on invoice and add the reverse-charge clause).
- Billing contact: Maria Santos <maria.santos@evergreenbio.com>, +44 20 8123 4460 (disputes only).
- Remit entity: Evergreen Bio Ltd, account details attached (PO_9876.pdf).
- We will start portal enrollment this week; please keep email copies on until we confirm webhook is receiving files.

Please send one sample invoice populated with PR-9876 and the VAT info ahead of the first billing run so AP can test ingestion.

Appreciate it — Emma

Emma Liu
AP Lead, Evergreen Bio
emma.liu@evergreenbio.com

-- Attachment stubs referenced in thread: sample_invoice_redwood_001.pdf (PDF stub, 1 page), invoice_xml_sample.xsd (XSD schema text), onboarding_checklist.xlsx (Excel stub), vat_evidence_template.pdf (PDF stub), PO_9876.pdf (PDF stub containing PO and bank remit).
